sourceQuote: B.A. Investment Objectives: The Investment specialty aims to educate students with a high quality of professional knowledge to meet the need of the construction of the socialist market economy and the need of many other fields concerned with investment.
targetQuote: 经济学学士投资专业培养目标：投资专业旨在培养学生具备高水平的专业知识，以满足社会主义市场经济建设的需要以及投资相关其他领域的需求。
